envelope.description: Ship the DeployStepProtocol + DeploymentContextBundle type contracts (sc1/sc2)

body.title: Ship the DeployStepProtocol + DeploymentContextBundle type contracts (sc1/sc2)
body.summary: Create src/mcp/deploy-step/types.ts carrying the flat a1 envelope field-for-field: DeployPhase union, DeployStepRequest, DeployStepResponse, DeployStageRegistrar (sc1) plus the DeploymentEntityRef/DeploymentRelationRef/DeploymentCitation/DeploymentContextBundle quartet (sc2). Joins the analyze-step/build-step/workflow-step envelope family; PascalCase types in a kebab-case file, kept independent of AnalyzeContextBundle's internal layers. This is the root contract every other piece and all of s2–s6 consume verbatim.
acceptanceChecks: Exports DeployStepRequest{phase;repo?;state?;focus?;payload?}, DeployStepResponse{next;guidance;prompt?;schema?;state;markdown?}, and DeployStageRegistrar{stage;register():void} field-for-field per the sc1 interfaceSketch (flat, no per-phase discriminated union).

Exports DeploymentEntityRef, DeploymentRelationRef, DeploymentCitation (entityId optional), and DeploymentContextBundle{stage;summary;entities[];relations[];citations[]} per the sc2 sketch, with no structural dependency on AnalyzeContextBundle.
Compiles under strict + exactOptionalPropertyTypes with every optional property typed as `| undefined`, and imports use `.js` extensions / `import type`.
